The GPS device also receives signals from other GPS devices and from ground stations. This shape called a “parabolic” arc is what allows the GPS signal to reach its highest and lowest points and this determines the position of the GPS device, which in turn determines the accuracy.  
It’s also worth noting that GPS devices can be used not just to get to known locations, but they can also help you find others nearby.  This is accomplished through a process called “collaborative location determination”.
